name: Observer
summary: Reads the conversations you choose, read only, and files what matters: classified first, then sent to Knowledge, Task Board or you.
description: Observer watches the conversations you share with it through Connect (read only) and turns them into records: grouped by thread, checked for secrets and personal data by fixed rules, and routed by your rules to Knowledge (as drafts by default), Task Board or a person in Operator Inbox. Anything with personal data or no matching rule waits for your review. Secrets are never kept. Live reading is off until you press Start; message text is kept 30 days by default. Observer never sends, edits or deletes a message.

intents: read my slack history into knowledge
watch a channel and file what matters

operations.title: Observer status
operations.description: What Observer watches and how far it got: sources with live and history state, and how many records wait for the owner. Labels and counts only — never message text, senders or titles.

operations.title: Pause an Observer job
operations.description: Pause a live or history job (for example when it reads too much). Only the owner can start, resume or cancel jobs.

operations.title: Flag a delivered record
operations.description: Send a record that Observer delivered back to the owner's Review (for example a Knowledge document that is wrong or should not exist), with a reason. An id Observer did not deliver answers not_found.

account.description: One account: its conversations, history flag and kept days (one data_catalog call). Without it: the shared accounts only.

targets.description: Apps Observer can call now (the slice lets the app reach them). The owner UI greys a destination that is not in the list.

operations.description: Deliver, deliver redacted, or drop a waiting record. Secret-class records can only be dropped.

acknowledged.description: Required (true) to deliver a record held as a possible secret as it is (decision deliver). Deliver redacted needs no acknowledgement.

revision.description: The revision of the record the owner read. A newer revision answers 409 revision_changed and nothing is decided.

operations.title: Retry a delivery

operations.description: Text retention (1–365 days, default 30), review retention (default 90) and what happens when a provider deletes a message.

operations.description: Delete stored message text now (of one source, or older than a date). Message ids stay so nothing is read twice.
